method: Category 2 checklist from eval_error_analysis.py, applied by reading each generation in eval/generations_topk40.json. Rules were fixed before generation and were not adjusted. Scored by Claude (the coding agent), not by a human reader. Conventions: animals and people count as characters (2c), inanimate things as objects (2a); outdoor scenery (trees, grass, sky, bushes) is treated as generic and not flagged under 2a; a generation truncated by the token cap has no ending, so 2d is false by default.
